text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Prix Niel. Upon arriving at 
ParisLongchamp Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! There are so many 
guests...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
With the Prix Niel held today... it's the 
"Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" Trials Day... 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Which means...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So you've got your sights set on someone 
else, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: “Now then—let us go♪”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Venus Park! Venus Park breaks away! She 
crosses the line in magnificent first 
place!!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats on back-to-back G1 wins! 
Complete domination!" "Venus Park! The 
Princess of France!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: Merci beaucoup !

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all for your blessings! I love 
this country, and I love every one of 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"‘Which is precisely why—we must pursue 
even greater glory!! Allow me to present 
you with the finest gift I can offer this 
autumn.’"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
『First place in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, dedicated to all of you!』

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooooh!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Umamusume dashed effortlessly through 
the heavy turf, accelerating in the blink 
of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That was a GⅠ race, wasn't it...? And to 
win by that many lengths...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
These are the rivals we'll be contending 
with at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Don't let them intimidate you. And Trainer 
<username>, don't forget your job either.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"This is our only race before the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe itself."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
At the 2,400 meters of ParisLongchamp 
Racecourse, you need to determine right 
here what skills your trainee Umamusume 
truly requires.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The French race is finally approaching. 
Will she be able to use this as a stepping 
stone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curtain rises on <chrname>'s first race of the 
French tour—
